data.name: The Climb
data.detailed_description:
Can you rise above the challenge?

The Climb is a parkour-inspired game about a pig who dreams of reaching the stars! Can you help this pig climb his way up to the top of the world? Or will you give up trying in this challenging yet rewarding game?!

Realistic Physics

Features parkour traversal and movement to enable players to have speedy yet accurate movement throughout the game.

Punishing Gameplay

This game has no checkpoints throughout the entire map! If you fall, you'll have to continue from wherever you might land.

Challenging Map

Whether it be dodging giant hammers or timing the perfect jump between moving platforms, the map includes multiple different obstacles that keeps the experience fresh and difficult.

Power Up System

Use built-in powerups to your advantage to make jumps you didn't think you could reach, to speed through the map with faster times, or even to save yourself from a long fall. Although, you do have a limited amount of uses for these powers... so be smart!

Leaderboard Rankings

Your time to reach the peak is recorded with each completion. Check the leaderboards to compare yourself to other players. The best player at the end of each month may just get a special prize!

Features

  • Third Person Character gameplay

  • Controller and Keyboard/Mouse compatibility

  • Singleplayer

data.short_description: The Climb is a casual platformer game which involves accurate jumps through different obstacles and speedy gameplay as you rise to the very top. Try not to fall though as you only continue wherever you land. Complete the game with a record time and you can even obtain a piece of art in real life!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 64-bit Windows 10
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD, 2.5 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 compatible with 2 GB VRAM (e.g., NVIDIA GTX 770 or AMD Radeon R9 280)
  • Sound Card: Any
  • VR Support: No

  • Sound Card: Any
